task_selection: A conversion/deployment, I version compatibility, E diagnosis; selected by task type before new runs, reused historical question wording. These are pilot cases, not independent heldout validation.
budgets_rationale: Same prior standard budget for all models, practical condition rather than theoretically optimal threshold. Save all returned results; M1 examines first five list positions.

tool_environment.context: fresh temp working directory and session; memory-disable env flags; not an OS isolation guarantee

assessment: same GLM automated assessor for all runs; sources/prior separated from final outcome; exact quote audit; no score-based retries; same-model assessor bias possible
limits: Three task pairs do not establish general or cross-ecosystem validity
Model aliases are not immutable backend versions
M11 null if inputs unknown/not applicable; no imputation
